description: Submission of the Ventilation Strategy Report pursuant to condition 35 of planning permission 251293VAR dated 23.02.2026 for 'Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no.2 (approved plans), seeking to allow changes on the ground floor, unit numbers and co-living amenity space and design changes, in pursuant to planning permission reference 235015FUL dated 28/03/2025 for: Construction of a building stepped from 4 to 9 storeys comprising co-living units (Sui Generis) and associated communal amenity facilities and ground floor commercial space (Use Classes E(a), E(b) and F2(b); and associated refuse storage and cycle parking'
